investigation: PSI-106, SLICE: laminar coflow jet diffusion flames in the Microgravity Science Glovebox, stepped up line by line to blow-off
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_slice_w0.md, section 7: lifting and blow-off of a jet flame base held by an edge that burns against the gas speed it feels. One case is one logged line (one setting of one flame); the per-line blow-off probability builds in a fixed step of 10 %. Derived case inputs (SI conversions, fuel indicators) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.

features.name: x_fuel
features.description: hydrocarbon mole fraction of the jet gas

features.name: mdot_jet
features.description: jet gas mass flow (mdot_jet_mg_s / 1e6); read by flame_length only

targets.name: blow_off
targets.description: the flame blows off at this logged setting, or during the adjustment noted on its line

targets.name: lifted
targets.description: the flame base has left the rim at this setting

targets.name: flame_length
targets.description: luminous length (lane-local; not scorable from text)
